title: RSVP collaborative BCI dataset from Zheng et al 2020
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from a collaborative brain-computer interface (BCI) study using a rapid serial visual presentation (RSVP) paradigm with human vs non-human target image detection. Fourteen healthy right-handed participants were recorded in synchronized pairs (7 dyads) across two sessions each, using 62-channel EEG. The data are converted into BIDS format with HED-annotated events for target and non-target stimuli, and derived using MOABB.
methods_description: EEG was recorded at 1000 Hz using a 62-channel Neuroscan Synamps2 system referenced to vertex (Cz), following the standard_1020 montage. Participants performed an RSVP target detection task (human vs non-human images) in synchronized pairs, with visual stimuli presented at a 100 ms stimulus onset asynchrony, across two sessions and three runs per session.
